Subject: Redwood x Aurelia Health Case study request
Hi Priya,
Thanks again. We'd love to feature Aurelia Health in a short case study. Could we do a 30-min recorded chat? We'll send a consent form and a draft for approval before publishing.

Dave (Redwood)
